decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - All advertisements displays, and any site used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a clean and tidy condition to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 2 - Any structure or hoarding erected or used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a safe condition.
Condition : 3 - Where any advertisement is required under these regulations to be removed, the removal shall be carried out to the reasonable satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant planning permission.

Condition : 5 - It is considered that this application for the retention of 2 projecting signs, 1 monolith sign, 1 post mounted header sign and 1 internally illuminated landscape sign, would not have a significant adverse upon adjoining residential occupiers or character and appearance of the area.  On balance, the development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and ENV.1.4 (Advertisements) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003; It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
description: Retention of 1 x internally illuminated 1422mm x 3918mm monolith sign, 1 x internally illuminated 891mm x 5620mm projecting sign, 1 x internally illuminated landscape sign and 1 x post mounted header sign (725mm x 1380mm) to existing site.
